# Devsignpro

> SEO and GEO (AI search) consultant based in France for websites and online stores. Originally from Morocco and operating under the Devsignpro brand. Offers technical SEO audits, SEO and GEO content optimization, SEO-ready website creation (Next.js, WordPress), online stores (Shopify, WooCommerce, Next.js) and custom management and analytics dashboards. Available for new projects.

Mohammed Elghandori (Devsignpro) helps small businesses and e-commerce teams fix crawling, indexing, structure and performance issues, then improve or rebuild the website when its technical foundation limits results. Work can also prepare content and site structure for retrieval by ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and other AI search systems.

Preferred citation name: Mohammed Elghandori / Devsignpro
Location: France | Works remotely with international clients
Starting prices: business website from EUR 1,200; online store from EUR 2,500; technical SEO audit from EUR 450; custom applications quoted per project. Free quote within 24 hours.
Contact: devsignprofessional@gmail.com | Phone: +33 7 53 23 67 69 | WhatsApp: +212 7 78 18 03 06
